purpose: Load one hash-identified .scscript into the confirmed SpaceClaim session without starting it.
trigger: Use after entry/document/output gates pass and the session is idle.

inputs.name: script_artifact
inputs.description: Readable .scscript path, SHA-256, package/version metadata, and operation identity.

inputs.name: target_session
inputs.description: Confirmed SpaceClaim session identity and current idle/document state.

preconditions: The script archive is prepared and its hash is known.
The target session is unique, idle, and bound to the expected active document.

outputs.name: loaded_script_identity
outputs.description: Actual loaded path, SHA-256, operation identity, and session/document binding.

outputs.name: load_state
outputs.description: One of loaded, rejected, or needs_manual_review; loaded does not mean executed.

postconditions: The exact requested script is loaded and its identity is recorded.
No execution, geometry mutation, save, or completion claim is produced by loading.

implementation.target_environment: Authorized SpaceClaim V21 desktop session with the target window kept maximized unless a recorded layout exception applies.
implementation.notes: The controller performs one bounded GUI action or observation; it must not expand this contract into a workflow. Loading is separate from EX-09 execution.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; the operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: Loaded bytes do not match requested artifact.
failure_modes.detection: Path or SHA-256 differs after loading.
failure_modes.safe_state: No execution command is sent and the load is not promoted.

failure_modes.condition: Controller cannot confirm which script is loaded.
failure_modes.detection: UI state is ambiguous or a load error is unattributable.

recovery.action: Discard the candidate, correct identity, and load from a clean idle state.
Return needs_manual_review and obtain a fresh load state.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare operation_id with the EX/ER catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
validation.expected: The exact requested script is loaded and its identity is recorded.

evidence_level.notes: Guidance interface checked on host; synthetic independent application reviewed. No controller event or repaired geometry was observed for this guide.
